en: Welcome to Floccesy Town! Now then, {player}. How are your Pokémon feeling?
They always give their best for you. Look after them in return!
My house is just up the street. Stop in at the Pokémon Center first, if you like.
There you are! This way, and we'll start your training. Hm? Why are you carrying two Town Maps?
Oho! It's your friend's, is it? The lad with the {rivalstarter}?
He went by not long ago, all fired up. I believe he was heading for the ranch off Route 20.
Deliver that map first, then come back to me. Just follow this road east, it goes to Route 20.
Follow the road east to Route 20. I'll wait here until you've given your friend his map.
Ah! You've given your friend his map. You were only gone a little while, but you both look a bit stronger.
Come on in, then. Time for some training!
Have you rested your Pokémon? My house is just up the street.
Take that map to your friend first. Route 20 is east of here.
